SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, u.username, COALESCE(u.image, 'default_avatar.png') AS image, p.view_count, p.reply_count, p.last_reply_time, p.collect_count FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 0 ORDER BY p.is_top DESC, p.last_reply_time DESC
